A fast, lightweight, tvOS 26 & macOS–inspired home screen for Android TV & Google TV — built in pure Java with zero third-party runtime dependencies ( ~30 MB private RAM / ~38 MB total PSS, 0.0% background CPU ). Designed to stay buttery-smooth even on 1 GB RAM TV boxes while bringing a resizable Liquid Glass Dock ( 50%–150% ) , rotating Night Scenes , Custom Wallpapers ( Custom 1..5 ) + Wallpaper Folder Shuffle , a Built-In Lock Screen / Idle Screensaver , an App Icon Changer & Interactive Icon Editor , Automatic GitHub App Updates , a built-in PC-free CleanYourTV Debloater (341 TV models + Manual System App Debloater + Stock Launcher Disabler) , a Customizable Glass Control Panel ( Quick Settings ) overlay , a Recent Apps Switcher , multi-tap ( 1x / 2x / 3x ) Remote Button Remapping + Send Key Code + Home Button Fix , and Dual-Mode Secure Local ADB Setup (Self-Repair & Volume Hold Fix without keeping port 5555 open) to any Android TV.
Dual-Mode ADB Security Architecture & One-Tap ADB Toggle ( Settings → Advanced & First-Time Setup) : Secure Mode (Grant Once & Close ADB — Default & Recommended) : Grants WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS and DUMP once during setup and immediately closes network ADB ( adb_enabled = 0 ) so port 5555 is never left open on your LAN. Restores Accessibility ( ServiceRepair ) and runs the Volume Button Hold Fix directly in-process with ADB completely turned off. Persistent ADB Mode (Opt-In with Confirmation Popup) : Optional mode for users who want network ADB kept open for runtime ADB tools like CleanYourTV. Selecting Persistent Mode while ADB is off prompts to enable USB Debugging and switch automatically; turning ADB off automatically returns to Secure Mode. One-Tap Turn On / Turn Off ADB Button : Toggle USB Debugging ( adb_enabled ) on or off directly from Settings → Advanced without enabling Wireless Debugging ( adb_wifi_enabled ). Device Admin Removed & Keep Alive Opt-In : Completely removed BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN (screen-off uses Android 9+ GLOBAL_ACTION_LOCK_SCREEN ) so the launcher never blocks uninstallation, and made background Keep Alive opt-in ( Off by default).

Includes a dedicated Lock Screen Settings sub-menu to pick any Night Scene, Classic Wallpaper, Custom 1–5, or Folder Shuffle , configure Clock Position ( Left / Center / Right ) , and display the glass clock, date, greeting, and live weather over the wallpaper (pressing any key returns immediately).

Universal Volume Button Hold Fix with Mode Selector ( Mode 1 / Mode 2 in Settings → Button Mapper ) : Works in both Secure Mode (ADB Off) and Persistent ADB Mode and adds a Volume button fix mode selector: Mode 1 (Standard — Default) : Standard volume hold behavior ( 320ms initial delay, 85ms repeat) without IR pulse-burst injection, preventing unintended volume runaway on standard IR TV remotes. Mode 2 (HY320 / Projector) : Enhanced AudioService Binder dump watcher ( Audio event log: volume changes + Events log: volume changes ) with 280ms repeat delay and single-event IR pulse-burst handling for Magcubic HY320 and Android 9–12 projectors.
